message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is special because it can be counted as **either 1 or 11**—whichever benefits your hand most.  
- If counting it as 11 keeps your total ≤ 21, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- If adding 11 would bust you, the Ace automatically counts as 1 instead.  

So an Ace is “flexible”: it’s valued at 11 unless doing so would cause a bust, in which case it becomes 1. This dual value is what makes Aces so valuable in the game.
